# an AI France that has opened a political camp but still has no leader after 60 days gets one
FRW_ai_political_fallback = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_end_disjointed_government NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_front_populaire } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_union_nationale } NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = FRW_backer_blum has_country_flag = FRW_backer_reynaud has_country_flag = FRW_backer_deat has_country_flag = FRW_backer_pending_dem } } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_dem } }
			set_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_dem
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = FRW_ai_gate_dem days > 60 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = FRW_france_ai_behavior option = HISTORICAL } }
				FRW_ai_backer_blum = yes
			}
			else = {
				random_list = { 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_blum = yes } 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_reynaud = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_proclaim_the_commune NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_thorez_party_line } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_pivert_revolution } NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = FRW_backer_thorez has_country_flag = FRW_backer_pivert has_country_flag = FRW_backer_besnard has_country_flag = FRW_backer_pending_com } } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_com } }
			set_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_com
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = FRW_ai_gate_com days > 60 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = FRW_france_ai_behavior option = HISTORICAL } }
				FRW_ai_backer_thorez = yes
			}
			else = {
				random_list = { 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_thorez = yes } 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_pivert = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_national_revolution NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_la_rocque_psf } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_doriot_ppf } NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = FRW_backer_larocque has_country_flag = FRW_backer_doriot has_country_flag = FRW_backer_pending_fasc } } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_fasc } }
			set_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_fasc
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = FRW_ai_gate_fasc days > 60 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = FRW_france_ai_behavior option = HISTORICAL } }
				FRW_ai_backer_larocque = yes
			}
			else = {
				random_list = { 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_larocque = yes } 50 = { FRW_ai_backer_doriot = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_suspend_the_chambers NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_etat_francais } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_orleanist_restoration } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_bonapartist_appeal } NOT = { has_completed_focus = FRW_legitimate_heir } NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = FRW_backer_petain has_country_flag = FRW_backer_orleans has_country_flag = FRW_backer_bonaparte has_country_flag = FRW_backer_legit has_country_flag = FRW_backer_captain has_country_flag = FRW_backer_pending_na } } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_na } }
			set_country_flag = FRW_ai_gate_na
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = FRW_ai_gate_na days > 60 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = FRW_france_ai_behavior option = HISTORICAL } }
				FRW_ai_backer_petain = yes
			}
			else = {
				random_list = { 25 = { FRW_ai_backer_petain = yes } 25 = { FRW_ai_backer_orleans = yes } 25 = { FRW_ai_backer_bonaparte = yes } 25 = { FRW_ai_backer_legit = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
}
